info.title: CSE 341 Project 2 API
info.description: REST API performing full CRUD operations on the contacts, users, colleges, courses, and instructors collections in MongoDB. All routes include data validation and error handling, and return proper HTTP status codes. Every POST, PUT, and DELETE route requires an authenticated GitHub session and returns 401 otherwise. To try a protected route in Swagger UI, open /login in a browser and sign in with the same host, then reload this page.
